Package com.hiface.sdk.flow

Enum FaceFlowStage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FaceFlowStage>
com.hiface.sdk.flow.FaceFlowStage
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<FaceFlowStage>
public enum FaceFlowStage extends java.lang.Enum<FaceFlowStage>
Current stage of guided capture, liveness, or dynamic verification. Each flow uses only some stages. Display the current value without assuming a fixed order.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    FACE_FORWARD
    The final stage passed its soft deadline.
    FACE_NOT_FRONTAL
    The final stage has started, but the pose does not meet the requirements yet.
    FACE_TOO_SMALL
    The only detected face is too small.
    FACE_UNSTABLE
    Guided capture is still checking stability or the face box is moving; the stability countdown has not started.
    HOLD_STILL
    The pose is eligible; waiting for the stability period to finish.
    MULTIPLE_FACES
    More than one eligible face was found.
    PERFORM_ACTION
    Waiting for the user to complete the action shown by the host.
    WAITING_FOR_FACE
    There is no eligible face in the image.
